messages.subject: Re: Display Format Questions in 3.6
messages.body_plain:
Also there is another similar issue with factors.
Data Viewer in the new version is showing the levels rather than the values.

Examples:
vals1<-factor(c(2014,2015,2016))   # Data Viewer correctly shows 
2014,2015,2016
vals2<-factor(c("a","b","a"))  # Data Viewer correctly shows a,b,a

y <- data.table(vals1)  #Data Viewer incorrectly shows 1,2,3 in new 
version, should show 2014,2015,2016
z <- data.table(vals2)  #Data Viewer incorrectly shows 1,2,1 in new 
version, should show a,b,a

I believe that the old version Data Viewer behaved in the correct way.

Thanks,

Don
